XoBanana Bread
By: Adam Paul Green
Published: Monday, October 3, 2011 - 1:58pm

Ingredients




2 cup 	100% Whole Wheat Flour
1 tsp 	Baking Soda
1/4 cup 	Salt
1/4 cup 	Butter
3/4 cup 	Brown Sugar
2 whole 	Eggs, beaten
2 1/3 cup 	Mashed overripe bananas
1 oz 	        Xocai Activ Powder
3 chunk 	Xocai X Power Squares, chopped
2 chunk 	Xocai Omega Squares, chopped

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Lightly grease 9x5-inch loaf pan. In large bowl, combine flour, baking soda and salt. In a separate bowl, cream butter and brown sugar. Stir in eggs and mashed bananas until well blended. Stir in Activ, X Power and Omega Squares. Stir banana mixture into flour mixture; stir just to moisten. Pour batter into prepared pan. Bake in preheated oven for 60 to 65 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into center of the loaf comes out clean. Let bread cool in pan for 10 minutes; turn out onto wire rack. Serves 4

About

Banana bread has just met it's match! Combine ripe bananas and "Xocai Healthy Dark Chocolate" for a moist and delicious bread.
